 Cancer Council shows ‘Every Bottle Does More’ in new summer sun protection campaign via TRP 
 November 19 2026, 12:16 pm | BY Ricki Green | No Comments 
 Cancer Council’s new summer sun protection campaign, created by TRP, highlights how every one of its branded products contributes to something bigger, helping support Cancer Council’s mission to reduce the impact of cancer for all Australians.
 ‘Every Bottle Does More’ draws on a simple insight: what people know about an organisation’s expertise shapes their confidence in its products. By showing the work behind every bottle, Cancer Council reminds Australians that its sunscreen is backed by decades of expertise in sun safety, and highlights how every purchase supports Cancer Council’s work to reduce the impact of cancer through world-leading research, prevention initiatives, advocacy and support services for Australians affected by cancer.
 The campaign also features Cancer Council’s broader licensed portfolio, including hats, sunglasses, swimwear, shade and tint products, demonstrating how the comprehensive range of sun protection solutions helps Australians to take action and protect themselves every day.
 Says Arianne Reisner, Head of Brand Licensing and Corporate Partnerships, Cancer Council Australia: “The Cancer Council brand appears across a range of products that support Australians every day, from sunscreen and hats through to shade, swimwear and sunglasses. This campaign brings that portfolio together under a shared purpose, helping consumers better understand the connection between the products they purchase and Cancer Council’s wider mission.”
 Says Lucinda Sabo, GM of Marketing & Digital, Vitality Brands Worldwide: “As Cancer Council’s sunscreen partner, we know the confidence people place in the name when choosing sun protection. ‘Every Bottle Does More’ gives Australians a fuller picture of what that name stands for, reinforcing trust in the products while showing how their purchase supports Cancer Council’s wider work.”
 Says Kyle Ross, Head of Strategy, TRP: “People know Cancer Council sunscreen. The real opportunity was to reveal more of the organisation behind it. Every bottle of sunscreen is backed by decades of work to prevent and treat cancer. ‘Every Bottle Does More’ magnifies that connection, giving Australians another reason to choose Cancer Council.”
 The campaign launches across streaming TV, video platforms, social and out-of-home.
